turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire, your order is verified. A refund of this size needs a decision from our staff, so I've passed your request to a colleague. They will take over and contact you. I can't promise the refund yet. The return rule says catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer Claire Fontaine (SC-3744) wants to return "Last Lantern" 40x50 cm (limited, 1350 RON, delivered 2026-11-09) for a refund because she ordered the wrong size. Policy flags it as a large refund, so staff must decide.
